# WhatCode

> WhatCode is the OpenCode mobile app for iPhone. It connects to the OpenCode AI coding agent running on your machine, so you can monitor sessions, send messages and get push notifications when an agent finishes. iPad is not supported yet.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://www.whatcode.app/): what WhatCode is and how it works
- [Getting Started](https://www.whatcode.app/getting-started/): connect the OpenCode iOS app to your machine
- [WhatCode](https://www.whatcode.app/whatcode/): features of the OpenCode iOS app
- [Screenshots](https://www.whatcode.app/screenshots/): the OpenCode iOS app on iPhone
- [Daemon](https://www.whatcode.app/daemon/): push notifications and remote access over Tailscale
- [FAQ](https://www.whatcode.app/faq/): OpenCode mobile app, iOS, iPad and Android questions
- [Pricing](https://www.whatcode.app/pricing/): subscription plans and free trial
- [Support](https://www.whatcode.app/support/): troubleshooting
